scope: standalone web playback controls; no extension work

checks: Default modes are off; cue navigation starts real YouTube playback.
Auto-pause stopped at displayed 0:18 and 0:20; explicit resume advanced to the next cue.
Choosing 0.75x changed the displayed confirmed speed; reopening the material restored 0.75x in the same origin.
Loop activation turned off auto-pause and replayed the current cue; selecting a word paused playback and Continue resumed it.
Physical D with page focus advanced to the next cue; typing ss in the vocabulary search kept playback paused at 0:18.
Compose installation displays all controls, speed and keyboard help; seek from unstarted state to 0:15 retained pause.

listening_integration: Automated: end sample is counted before loop seek, discontinuities do not count skipped audio, replays do not duplicate completed cues, 0.5x and 2x support.
limits: Final-video-frame loop is checked in the boundary controller; a full real-video ending was not replayed.
Focus inside the YouTube iframe uses YouTube shortcuts; page shortcuts are documented beside the controls.
